CustomObject.description: MOCK data, not a live feed (D-096). One row per order with what the delivery platform would send: driver GPS distance when the order was marked delivered, wait time, calls and chats to the customer, driver history, fraud flags and re-dispatch eligibility. Read by CARES_StolenDelayedMockTelemetry when CARES_Stolen_Delayed_Policy__mdt.Mock_Telemetry_Enabled__c is on. No photo fields on purpose.
CustomObject.label: CARES Delivery Telemetry
